In Lesson 23, they return to this strategy to break apart three-digit minuends and subtract from the hundred.  For example, in Grade 1, students solved 14 – 9 by restating the problem as 10 – 9 + 4.  In Grade 2, students use the same strategy to restate 143 – 90 as 100 – 90 + 43.
